name: QrShare
title: QrShare
summary: A QR code beside a short prompt with Copy link and Share buttons, so someone can pass a dot.bible link to a person standing next to them.
whenToUse: Use on language pages, TAP/NFC card pages and event screens where people share in person.
Use the dark variant on dark sections and kiosks.
Inside a BibleCard, use the card's built-in share block (same `.sx-qr`).
whenNotToUse: Do not use as the only way to reach a link; the Copy link button is required.

anatomy.description: `.sx-qr` (128px, white, 6px padding) + text column (title, copy, buttons, status).

props.name: variant
props.description: `light`: secondary buttons on a white card. `dark`: outline-light buttons on charcoal.

props.name: qrSrc
props.description: URL of a precomputed QR code image (black on white, with its own quiet zone). Use this or `children`. No QR library is bundled.

props.name: children
props.description: A precomputed QR as an inline `<svg>` (or any node), used instead of `qrSrc`.

props.name: qrLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the QR naming the address it opens, for example "QR code for dot.bible/burmese".

props.name: title
props.description: Title, for example "Share with someone nearby".

props.name: text
props.description: Short prompt naming the language and the short address.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Visible label of the Copy link button.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Visible label of the Copy link button after copying, for example "Copied". Defaults to `copyLabel`.

props.name: shareLabel
props.description: Visible label of the Share button, for example "Share…".

props.name: hideShare
props.description: Hide the Share button where the system share sheet is unavailable.

props.name: copied
props.description: The link was just copied: swaps the Copy icon to a check and the label to `copiedLabel`.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called when Copy link is pressed. Keep focus on the button.

props.name: status
props.description: Status message announced politely, for example "Link copied: dot.bible/urdu". Keeps its height when empty.

variantNotes: States: default (empty status line); copied (Copy link swaps its icon to a check and its label to "Copied"; status reads "Link copied: dot.bible/urdu" in `--horizon-blue-dim`, or `--blue-on-dark` on dark). Under 480px the block stacks: QR above the text, padding `--space-5`.

states.documented: default (empty status line); copied (Copy link swaps its icon to a check and its label to "Copied"; status reads "Link copied: dot.bible/urdu" in `--horizon-blue-dim`, or `--blue-on-dark` on dark).
states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: QR is always black on a white tile, even on dark sections, with a quiet zone (the 6px padding plus the code's own margin).
Keep the QR at least 128px on screen; never below 120px.
Two buttons only, both secondary: Copy link, then Share…. No Horizon Blue button here.
Share… opens the system share sheet where available; the ellipsis signals a further step.
The status line keeps its height (`min-height:1.5em`) so the layout does not jump.
Buttons meet the 44px tap target on touch screens; `.btn-sm` is acceptable on desktop only.

accessibility: The QR is `role="img"` with an `aria-label` that names the address it opens.
The copy confirmation is in `role="status"` so screen readers announce it.
Button icons are `aria-hidden="true"`; the text names the action.
After copying, keep focus on the button.
Write the short URL visibly in the copy or status so people can type it.
content: Copy: "Point a phone camera at the code to open the Burmese Bible on dot.bible."
Status: "Link copied: dot.bible/burmese". Short addresses only, no https://.
